full_name: Rebecca Louise Carter | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Social Sciences Radcliffe Institute Fellow Brown University
bio: Rebecca Louise Carter is an assistant professor of anthropology and urban studies at Brown University. Her research explores the past, present, and future of human dwelling, focusing on the evolution and impact of vulnerability and violence in historically marginalized communities and the everyday practices and movements of social and spiritual transformation in the making of an inclusive, just, and sustainable urban world.
